title: viewer-embed: postMessage between a BIM viewer and the Ginnung app popup
description: Draft 2026-11-13. The viewer opens the Ginnung app in a popup (window.open) and the two talk through window.postMessage. Both ends check event.source (the other window object) AND the exact event.origin, and always post to an explicit target origin, never '*'. Every message carries `v: 1` and a `type`; unknown types and extra fields are dropped with one warning.

ready.description: app -> viewer, once the app is loaded and its session state is known. The viewer answers with `hello`.

hello.description: viewer -> app. Tells the app the viewer is there and which model it shows. The app only trusts messages after a hello from its opener.

modelRef.description: The model the viewer shows. `document_id` and `version_index` are the Ginnung store's (contract models) when the model came from Ginnung; absent for a file opened locally.

selection.description: viewer -> app. The viewer's current selection, sent on every change (an empty list clears it) and once after `ready`. At most 512 GlobalIds (the cap of the tasks viewpoint).

modelUpdated.description: app -> viewer. A new version of a model was committed in the Ginnung store (a Gróa task finished, a build committed). The viewer fetches it from the Ginnung source (contract models) and loads it.
